1. (Currently amended) An Internet system that supports a search service, the Internet system comprising: a search server __implemented by computer hardware and__ adapted to receive search criteria from a client device remote from the search server; a historical data repository __implemented by computer hardware and__ coupled to the search server, wherein the historical data repository contains historical data collected from over the Internet, and wherein the search server stores data retrieved from over the Internet and eventually stores the data as historical data within the historical data repository when the data is no longer preserved in the search server; and wherein the search server receives the search criteria to search for older historical data that was in existence on the Internet at a previous time, wherein the search server obtains search results to satisfy the search criteria by searching the historical data stored in the historical data repository, __the historical data comprising archived Internet content from previous states of the Internet rather than merely a history of websites visited by a user__.

2. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is date tagged so that the historical data is associated with a date representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet __as archived Internet content from previous states of the Internet__.

3. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 2 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet __as archived Internet content from previous states of the Internet__.

4. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet __as archived Internet content from previous states of the Internet__.

5. (Previously presented) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the search server contains a cache memory that temporarily stores the data retrieved from over the Internet and eventually transfers the data to an archival database module that manages historical content within the search server and eventually moves historical content on the search server to the historical data repository to support historical searching.

6. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data repository comprises: central processing circuitry; communication circuitry coupled to the central processing circuitry for communicating data in to and out from the historical data repository; and local storage coupled to the central processing circuitry that contains an index storage module for storing historical data according to indices and a time based sorting module for storing historical data according to date and time, __the historical data being archived Internet content from previous states of the Internet rather than merely website visit history__.

7. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein certain data is removed from the historical data before it is placed for long-term storage within the historical data repository, __the removed certain data comprising data within the archived Internet content rather than websites selected based on a user-specific visit history__.

20. (Currently amended) A network browser __stored in a computer-readable memory of a computer and executed by a processor of the computer__ for browsing websites, the network browser comprising: a search criteria window that prompts a user to enter search terms and timeline information; a first module that enables a search of the Internet to determine search results that existed within a time frame delineated by the timeline information, and wherein the search results correlate to the search terms; and a second module that receives the search results from over the Internet.
